 Nobody hurt after late-night fire at storage unit 
 The Cedar Rapids Fire Department says nobody was hurt after a fire in a storage unit in Southwest Cedar Rapids. By KCRG Staff Published : Nov. 11, 2026 at 1:55 AM CST | Updated : 10 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google CEDAR RAPIDS, Iowa (KCRG) - The Cedar Rapids Fire Department says nobody was hurt after a fire in a storage unit on Tuesday night in Southwest Cedar Rapids.
 The department says it responded to the 2800 block of 16th Avenue SW at 11:36 P.M.
 Crews arrived to find heavy flames and smoke coming from a storage unit, there was nobody inside the unit but the renter was on the scene.
 Crews were able to put out the fire and had to force open a neighboring unit due to the extension of the flames. The unit suffered heavy fire damage and other units had smoke damage.
 The cause of the fire is under investigation.
